title: Lapsus$ member Arion Kurtaj sentenced to seven years, could be released the same day, Evening Standard reports
date_note: Source page was published on 23 November and says the sentence was handed down on Monday (23 November); it gives no earlier day.
geo_basis: Woolwich Crown Court, where the source says the sentence was passed
summary: The Evening Standard (via AOL) reports that Arion Kurtaj, described as a member of the Lapsus$ hacking gang who hacked companies including Rockstar, was sentenced to seven years in prison at Woolwich Crown Court on Monday. The judge said he could be released the same day because of his earlier hospital stay and time on remand. He also received a five-year Serious Crime Prevention Order barring him from Discord and Telegram.
plain: A UK court sentenced hacker Arion Kurtaj to seven years in prison, but the judge said he could be released the same day because of time already spent in hospital and on remand, the Evening Standard reports.
exec: A court case tied to the Rockstar hack ended in a seven-year sentence; the Evening Standard says release could be immediate.

sources.name: Evening Standard via AOL UK (23 November 2026)

validation.note: Only the AOL UK copy of the Evening Standard article was read; the Standard's own page could not be opened by the fetch tool, and no court or CPS page was read.
